sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 17 (check 16) and Internal Quality Checks row 17 (check 16; no extra annotation cells or comments)
task/tests/**/judge.toml and prompt.md (machine comparison for verbatim overlap with the notes)
evidence: Source inspection of the frozen bytes. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; there is no COPY of solution/ or tests/, and /app receives only 'touch /app/.gitkeep' plus the initial git commit. The global npm install is limited to 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1', i.e. runtime libraries, not a starter. (2) The build context task/environment contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes; no hidden files, starter, skeleton, schema or route list. (3) assets/seed_data.json is 149 bytes: '"snippets": []' plus a note 'No saved snippets are supplied in this seed.'; it carries no schema, source or UI. (4) The notes describe behaviour only and leave implementation open: policy.md 'You may choose the layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording'; integration.md fixes only the start command, port, GET /api/health and DB_PATH, which is the shared runtime contract, not a route list of the deliverable. (5) Grep of instruction.md, the six notes and the seed for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|solution|oracle|golden|cw_ returns no match. A word n-gram comparison of the notes and brief against every tests/ judge.toml and prompt.md found no shared run of 12 words, and none of 8 words against the judge.toml criteria, so the notes do not reproduce criterion text. (6) The reference app exists only under task/solution (about 127 KB of source), which the agent image never copies; solve.sh copies it into /app at oracle time only. Run evidence is indirect: the hosted run in the evidence index reports 'nop 0', consistent with an empty /app, but that was an earlier candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes. The Dockerfile and environment tree are static, so this row does not depend on a judge run. Not checked: the agent image was not built and listed in this review; the conclusion rests on the Dockerfile and build context.
